title: 1990 Fleer Action Series Team Logo Stickers Twins Yankees A’s Mariners
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a set of 1990 Fleer Action Series Team Logo Stickers featuring baseball teams such as the Twins, Yankees, and A's. These stickers are part of a sports trading card collection manufactured by Fleer, specifically highlighting teams from the American League. Perfect for collectors or fans of Major League Baseball, these stickers capture the essence of the 1990 baseball season with a unique and nostalgic touch.
